description: One versioned model catalogue, read by the Rust runtime and by the drawing (ADR 0115, scoped by ADR 0120). A row records what a vendor's documentation says about a model, with the source and the read-date that docs/PROVIDERS.md requires of every row it publishes. It is NOT a capability: what this build can operate is core::providers::model_capabilities, and neither answer is derived from the other. Nothing outside this file spells a model id; consumers name a row by its id, which is a stable slug rather than a model name, so a vendor's next generation is a change to model_id here and nowhere else.
